rows.name: Templar
cellsHtml: Tank aion2hub
Sword/mace + shield fextralife
Low, beginner-friendly to pick up, but more gear-dependent than it looks single source pvpbank
Dominates dungeon tanking and holds its own solo, but lowest damage of the melee/DPS classes single source kr-era pvpbank
Scales well into large-scale organized PvP as a durable frontline initiator single source pvpbank
Near-mandatory tank archetype for structured group PvE contested, inferred, no source gives a hard queue figure aion2hub
Moderate. Strong self-sustain via lifesteal and hit-scaling shields, but low personal damage can make clears feel slow pvpbank
aion2hub

rows.name: Gladiator
cellsHtml: Melee DPS, flexible off-tank aion2hub
Greatsword or Polearm mmom.com
Low-Medium, pitched as a forgiving, rhythm-based melee playstyle single source redwendy, KR

Strong for dungeons and bosses via AoE damage and self-heal, can sub-tank ssegold. Early levels reportedly felt "slow and clunky" in pre-release focus tests before a rebalance contested, kr-era fextralife lagofast, 2026

Excels in frontline skirmishes and small-scale fights (1v1, 2v2) via burst, mobility, and CC mmoexp. A role-based framing separately places it as combining "strong PvP with durability and party buffs" rather than a strict tier letter leprestore
Solid demand as a melee DPS that can flex to off-tank duty; no source gives a hard queue-priority figure u4n.com
High. Multiple sources call it one of the most stable, forgiving melee classes to solo via AoE clearing plus lifesteal confirmed, 2 sources u4n.com u4gm.com
aion2hub

rows.name: Assassin
cellsHtml: Melee DPS fextralife
Dual daggers, sword/bow secondary aion2hub
Hard. Called unsuited to new players due to a high skill floor, and separately "the highest skill ceiling" of the roster confirmed, 2 sources overgear timesaver.gg

Contested. "Considered the best PvE class for clearing content" per early focus-group rankings aion2hub, versus a tier list arguing it gains more from a short PvP fight than from sustained boss-parse damage contested exitlag
Top-tier PvP. "Was the KR launch problem child, too strong. Nerfs brought it back to earth. Still top-tier PvP" single source, kr-era ggwtb
Falls in the "damage" role bucket rather than the guaranteed-invite bucket (tank/healer/support) ggwtb
Levels efficiently once level 16/20 breakpoint skills are secured, but not the most beginner-forgiving due to positioning demands overgear
aion2hub

rows.name: Ranger
cellsHtml: Ranged physical DPS aion2hub
Bow aion2hub
Easy-Medium, called one of the more accessible damage options for new players confirmed, 2 sources overgear timesaver.gg

Contested. "Second-best PvE class for clearing content" per FGT rankings aion2hub, versus "sustained output stable, only slightly lower than Elementalist and Sorcerer" but "slightly squishy" and hurt by high ping contested leprestore
Contested. Called A-tier, "the cleanest roaming pick after Assassin" ggwtb, versus a separate summary from the same source cluster calling it "a stable B-tier pick" contested ggwtb
Damage role bucket, but called "one of the safest overall picks with strong performance plus long-term role demand" ggwtb
Comfortable and safe, benefits from ranged kiting and does not need to tank hits confirmed, 2 sources overgear timesaver.gg

rows.name: Sorcerer
cellsHtml: Magic DPS aion2hub
Spellbook fextralife
Very Hard. Placed in S-tier (hardest) "right beside Assassin," with almost no forgiveness for mistakes single source mmoexp
Contested. Graded "A, with a real claim on higher" aion2boost, versus a leaderboard-data tier list grading it C-tier with only 83 of 800 tracked slots contested allthings.how
Graded B single source aion2boost
Top-tier AoE and single-target burst with strong CC, but fragility ties it to positioning support from the party single source, unverified youtube, unverified
Lower than average. Sources repeat "pull to your control budget, not your damage" as the core habit for a fragile class aion2boost

rows.name: Spiritmaster
cellsHtml: Magic DPS, pet/summoner aion2hub
Orb fextralife

Easy-Medium, placed in the most beginner-friendly difficulty bracket single source mmoexp, though the rotation is said to be "deceptively demanding" once spirit-cycle management is factored in unverified, 403 exitlag, unverified

Strongly contested. Graded C aion2boost; graded D, the lowest of any class with only 34 of 800 leaderboard slots allthings.how; a separate search-summary claim puts it at A-tier as "the biggest winner of pre-launch balance passes" contested, one leg unverified leprestore, unverified

Graded C, but sources agree it offers safer, controlled ranged pressure with strong 1v1 fear-based CC, and tolerates lag better since "summons keep fighting through lag that cripples every reaction-based kit" aion2boost pvpbank
Strong for sustained pressure and solo self-sufficiency, more mechanically demanding in group content where boss movement disrupts spirit positioning aion2hub

Mace + shield/Guard, Staff for a more damage-leaning build oneall forum
Low. Framed as a forgiving, hard-to-kill class, though no source gives it an explicit numeric difficulty grade single source, inferred fextralife

Staff fextralife
Medium single source aion2boost

blocks.bodyAfterHtml:
Recommendations by what you want

  1. Easiest to learn: Ranger for a ranged playstyle, rated Easy-Medium and one of the more accessible damage classes for new players overgear1 timesaver.gg2, or Gladiator if you want melee, pitched as one of the more forgiving melee classes to learn redwendy, KR3. Avoid Assassin and Sorcerer as a first character, both rated Hard or harder overgear4 mmoexp5.
  2. Safest for a first character: Ranger again, explicitly called "one of the safest overall picks with strong performance plus long-term role demand," and comfortable to solo-level without needing to tank hits ggwtb6 overgear7.
  3. Best solo leveling: Spiritmaster, repeatedly called "one of the strongest solo classes" because its spirit acts as a built-in frontline tank aion2hub8 aion2boost9. Gladiator and Cleric are close, more forgiving seconds u4n.com10 fextralife11.
  4. Most wanted in dungeons: Cleric is confirmed near-mandatory as the only class that can actively dispel debuffs and carries a resurrection skill aion2hub12 fextralife13. Templar is the tank counterpart, though that "near-mandatory" framing is contested and inferred rather than backed by a hard queue statistic contested, inferred aion2hub14.
  5. Best PvP: Assassin is called top-tier PvP even after nerfs brought it "back to earth" ggwtb15, contested against Ranger's own claim to A-tier as "the cleanest roaming pick after Assassin" contested ggwtb16.
  6. Highest skill ceiling: Sorcerer, rated S-tier hardest to master mmoexp17, and Assassin, explicitly named as having "the highest skill ceiling" of the roster timesaver.gg18. No source ranks one clearly above the other.
Avoid taking any of this as settled: every tier and difficulty claim in this table is KR/TW-era, gathered before global launch and before any global balance pass. Several rest on boosting or carry-service tier lists marketing rather than independent testing, and even the more data-driven leaderboard source only reflects the KR/TW live meta, not global. Treat every ranking here as a snapshot that may already be stale by the October 5, 2026 global launch.
If you might want to swap classes later: none of the beginner-overview research for this guide documents a way to change an existing character's class, so switching later in practice means leveling a new character, an alt. Two facts from that research matter here. First, per-character systems including the Daeva Pass, Stigma builds, and gear do not share progress across characters, so trying a second class means rebuilding all of that from zero boostroom, 2026-0219 mein-mmo, 2026-0920. Second, once an account registers 84 combined dungeon clears within a single weekly lockout, tradeable Kinah and gear drops are reduced, one source says by 90 percent, for the rest of that week across every character on the account, not just the one that hit the threshold mmoexp, alt penalty21 youtube, kr-era22. In practice, rolling one or two alts to try a different class looks fine; heavily dungeon-farming your main and a would-be replacement class in the same week is exactly the pattern that penalty targets.
